description: This file defines a database migration class for the OrangeHRM system, specifically for version 5.8.0. It manages schema changes related to currency ID columns and foreign key constraints, and also handles localization string updates.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A class to perform schema migrations specific to OrangeHRM version 5.8.0, handling foreign key constraints, column modifications, and localization string updates.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs the main migration steps, including schema introspection, similarity checks, foreign key corrections, and localization string updates.

methods.name: correctingCurrencyIdColumnInconsistencies
methods.description: Adjusts the 'currency_id' columns and foreign keys to fix inconsistencies.

methods.name: getConflictingForeignKeys
methods.description: Retrieves foreign keys related to 'hs_hr_currency_type' that conflict with current schema.

methods.name: removeConflictingForeignKeys
methods.description: Drops foreign keys identified as conflicting.

methods.name: recreateRemovedForeignKeys
methods.description: Recreates previously removed foreign keys after adjustments.

methods.name: getNativeConnection
methods.description: Returns the native PDO connection object.

methods.name: disableForeignKeyChecks
methods.description: Disables foreign key checks in the database session.

methods.name: enableForeignKeyChecks
methods.description: Re-enables foreign key checks in the database session.

methods.name: getLangStringHelper
methods.description: Provides an instance of LangStringHelper for handling localization string updates.

methods.name: updateLangStringVersion
methods.description: Updates the version of language strings in the database.
